en.title: Happy New Year 🎉
description: Wishing you a strong start — new ideas, better systems, and smoother builds ahead.
A fresh start for better decisions, cleaner code, and calmer deployments.
New year, new iterations — may everything ship a little smoother this time.

et.title: Head uut aastat 🎉
description: Soovime tugevat algust ja sujuvamaid lahendusi.
Uus aasta, uued ideed ja paremad süsteemid.
Hea hetk alustada puhtalt lehelt.

en.title: Valentine’s Day ❤️
description: A good moment to appreciate the people and partnerships that make everything work better.
Behind every good system is good collaboration — this is a good day to value it.
Strong relationships are like good architecture — built with care over time.

et.title: Sõbrapäev ❤️
description: Hea hetk väärtustada inimesi ja koostööd.
Head suhted on nagu hea arhitektuur — need püsivad.
Tänu inimestele, kes teevad asjad võimalikuks.

en.title: International Women’s Day 🌸
description: Recognizing the people whose precision, perspective, and consistency improve every system they touch.
Better teams build better systems — today is about acknowledging that impact.
Strength in systems often starts with strength in people.

et.title: Naistepäev 🌸
description: Tunnustame inimesi, kes teevad süsteemid paremaks.
Head tiimid loovad paremad tulemused.
Tugevus algab inimestest.

en.title: Labor Day 🌿
description: A reminder that well-built systems — and well-rested people — both perform better.
Even the best architecture needs maintenance breaks.
Rest is not downtime — it’s part of performance.

et.title: Kevadpüha 🌿
description: Puhkus parandab nii inimesi kui süsteeme.
Hea süsteem vajab hooldust nagu ka inimene.
Puhkus on osa tulemuslikkusest.

en.title: Halloween 🎃
description: A creative break from structure — even good systems benefit from a bit of chaos.
Not every feature needs to be serious — some just need to be fun.
A reminder that experimentation is part of good engineering.

et.title: Halloween 🎃
description: Loominguline paus struktuurist.
Mõnikord on kaos osa protsessist.
Katsetamine viib paremate lahendusteni.

en.title: Holiday Season 🎄
description: Wishing you calm days, good people around you, and systems that behave themselves.
May your time off be as smooth as a well-optimized release cycle.
A good moment to pause, recharge, and let things run without friction.

et.title: Pühadeaeg 🎄
description: Rahulikud päevad ja hästi toimivad süsteemid.
Hea aeg puhata ja laadida end.
Aeg lasta asjadel lihtsalt töötada.

en.title: New Year’s Eve ✨
description: A good moment to reflect on what shipped well — and what should be rebuilt better.
Closing loops, reviewing progress, and preparing better systems for next cycle.
Every system improves when you take time to review it properly.

et.title: Vana-aasta õhtu ✨
description: Hea hetk vaadata tagasi ja teha paremaid otsuseid.
Kokkuvõtete aeg ja uute suundade planeerimine.
Iga süsteem paraneb, kui seda analüüsida.
